author: Patrikano
body:
Hi, This is something many walls players would like removed.

The kit, CookieMonster. Is incredibly over powered in some maps that has:
-Cookies
Or
-Wheat and Cocoa Beans

What cookie does, is that when you right click with it, You get a random (good) potion effect.

And sometimes you get the instant health effect, but see. if you just hold the right button while running away from a person that you were fighting and losing, you will at one stage or another get the instant health effect, giving you full hearts. 

So I suggest 2 options:

-Chance it so that the cookie can only give an effect when eaten, not just by right clicking (when full hunger bars) Or remove the health effect at all.

OR

-Remove kit altogether.

I'd like other opinions on this matter, As I feel I am not alone who hates how good cookie kit is.

-Pat
